before.summary: President Trump signed an executive waiver temporarily suspending newly enacted congressional sanctions and tariffs on Russia, drawing sharp criticism from Volodymyr Zelenskyy and bipartisan concern in Congress.

after.summary: Following the temporary suspension of congressional sanctions on Russia, President Trump defended the move as a peace measure while clashing with Ukrainian leadership over ongoing war aims, as Kyiv also welcomed a resumption of US intelligence sharing earlier in the week.

note: President Trump publicly defended the sanctions waiver as a peace measure while trading barbs with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

before.story: Violent Protests and Riots Across France
before.summary: Widespread demonstrations against rising living costs devolved into severe riots, looting, and clashes with police across multiple French cities earlier in the week, prompting thousands of arrests.

after.story: Violent Cost-of-Living Protests Spread to Italy
after.summary: Following days of severe riots, looting, and thousands of arrests across France over rising living costs, civil unrest spilled over into neighboring countries, with protesters clashing with police and looting stores in central Milan.

note: The widespread cost-of-living protests and violent riots expanded internationally from France into major Italian cities like Milan.

before.story: Violent Cost-of-Living Protests Spread to Italy
before.summary: Following days of severe riots, looting, and thousands of arrests across France over rising living costs, civil unrest spilled over into neighboring countries, with protesters clashing with police and looting stores in central Milan.

after.story: Violent Cost-of-Living Protests Spread to Italy
after.summary: Following days of severe riots, looting, and nearly 2,400 arrests across France over rising living costs, civil unrest spilled over into neighboring countries with protesters clashing with police in Milan as French authorities tallied the extensive property damage.

note: French interior ministry updated total arrest tally to nearly 2,400 across France as property damage was assessed.

before.summary: A serious incident at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta sparked a massive blaze that killed four service members and injured dozens more.

after.summary: Following a devastating blaze at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta that killed four service members, newly released updates confirmed the victims' identities and noted that dozens remain hospitalized with several in critical condition.

note: Authorities released the identities of the four deceased service members as dozens of injured personnel continue receiving hospital treatment.

before.story: Trump Overhauls Historic DC Golf Course

after.story: Trump Overhauls Historic DC Golf Course
after.summary: Despite ongoing legal challenges and a federal judge's blocking order, Donald Trump announced that the rapid renovation and redevelopment of the historic East Potomac golf course in Washington, D.C., will officially begin in November.

note: Donald Trump pushed forward with the redevelopment timeline, announcing that construction on the Washington golf course will begin in November despite a judge's restraining order.

after.summary: Mourners gathered in Waterford, Ireland, for the reposal of four family members who died in a fatal house fire, as Irish police officially filed criminal charges against two individuals in connection with the suspected arson.

note: Irish police formally filed criminal charges against two individuals connected to the fatal house fire.

after.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo's latest Ebola outbreak expanded to an eighth province while neighboring Kenya confirmed its first domestic cases, prompting international health teams to rapidly ramp up regional surveillance and containment measures.

note: The regional Ebola outbreak crossed international borders as Kenya confirmed its first cases alongside the disease's spread to an additional Congolese province.

before.story: Fatal Truck Crash at Kansas Game

after.story: Fatal Truck Crash at Kansas Game
after.summary: In the wake of a tragic incident where a pickup truck drove onto a crowded Wichita soccer field and killed a six-year-old boy and a man, prosecutors released the driver without filing immediate criminal charges.

note: The driver responsible for the fatal truck crash at the Kansas youth soccer field was released from custody without charges.
